name: Web build, preview, and deployment workflows
userOutcome: The user can build, test, preview, stage, and prepare deployment and rollback for web applications.
productionDataSource: Registered web repository, package tools, containers, databases, browsers, preview provider, tests, and approvals.
errorBehavior: Preserve logs and artifacts, distinguish migration, application, browser, provider, and health failures, and keep rollback available.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not deploy production without policy.
Do not run destructive migration without approval.
Do not report preview health from build success alone.
